snippet.title: The Binding of Isaac: Antibirth - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
After 2 years in development, we are proud to announce the imminent release of Antibirth, an unofficial but full fledged expansion for The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth. Featuring an improved local two-player mode, a whole new original soundtrack and heaps of new secrets waiting to be discovered! Coming December 20th, Windows only.

Visit http://www.antibirth.com for more information and daily updates!


Antibirth is a massive fan expansion for The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth that uses executable modding to add tons of brand new features to the game.
- A completely revisited local coop mode: play as 2 characters simultaneously!
- 90+ new items
- 18+ new trinkets
- 2 new characters with unique playstyles
- A new secret chapter, for those seeking a challenge
- 80+ new enemies
- 16 new bosses
- A nearly complete, brand new original soundtrack
- 40+ new achievements

Trailer by LeatherIceCream (https://www.youtube.com/user/LeatherIceCream) and Harvey Rothman (https://www.youtube.com/user/cookie123456789012).
Trailer music: https://soundcloud.com/garden_peeman/04-secret-room-forgotten-lullaby
